description: This file declares the interface for the MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService and its factory within the Rialto media server IPC layer. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to media key system capabilities management.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Implementation of the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService interface, managing media key system capabilities.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory::create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService::supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService::getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
